{{Quote|Don't let something as predictable as the weather get in the way of dispensing justice.|Rothana Engineering motto for the Purity|<ref name="IHB" />}}
The '''IM-X-981 hostile-environment garrison''', also known as '''The Purity''' was a relatively new line of Imperial garrisons specializing in extreme weather conditions created by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]].<ref name="IHB" />

==Characteristics==
A Purity possessed sealed airlocks that were space-rated<ref name="IHB" /> on all entry points on an extra life-support sub-level.<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref> It also possessed radiation shielding.<ref name="IHB" />
